# Bybit API Documentation 


[Introduction to the Bybit V5 APIs -- 5min ⏱️](/docs/v5/intro){.button .button--secondary .button--lg}










![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,){.featureSvg_GfXr}



### Unified APIs

Bybit\'s latest v5 suite of APIs allow for a smooth and easy integration.





![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,){.featureSvg_GfXr}



### Learn Exchange Mechanisms

**[Learn](https://www.bybit.com/en-US/help-center/HelpCenterKnowledge/bybitHC_Guides?language=en_US)** the intricate details of Bybit\'s market rules to fully maximise your API usage.





![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,){.featureSvg_GfXr}



### Historical Market Data

**[Get](https://public.bybit.com/)** comprehensive public market data in CSV format to speedily backtest and build strategies.
